purpose: Own-capture field dataset for closing the domain gap identified in docs/issue12/field-probe/metrics.md
session_convention: <桶>/<object-id>_s<session>_<nn>_<view>.jpeg — all images in the same s<session> MUST stay on one side of the train/test split

captures.source: handheld phone, classroom desk, monitor + white desk background
captures.notes: Thai-market Ovaltine biscuit pack, plastic film wrapper
crumpled side, mostly silver foil visible
pinched between fingers, mostly out of focus
Vitasoy no-added-sugar soymilk 330mL Tetra Pak, straw attached
held with straw up, partial occlusion by hand

labelling_rationale.biscuit_ovaltine: 塑膠包裝袋／複合材質零食袋 — 香港一般不算乾淨回收，歸入其他垃圾
labelling_rationale.drink-carton_vitasoy: 紙盒飲品（Tetra Pak）— 屬可回收物（清潔壓平後交紙盒回收）

known_risks: hand visible in most frames — model may learn hand/arm as a feature; future sessions should include object-only shots
fixed background (same desk + monitor) — background-shortcut risk documented in docs/issue12/field-probe/metrics.md
some frames out of focus / motion blur — kept deliberately, real usage has these
split_rule: session-based split only; never random. s1 currently exists; add s2/s3 with different background/light before training.
